School slang relates to Stonyhurst College in the United Kingdom.

s: A station for guards, especially at the entrance of a town, castle, etc.
m: a military facility that serves as the headquarters for military police and in which military prisoners can be detained

s: Someone who guards, watches over, or protects.
A person legally responsible for a minor (in loco parentis).
m: a person who cares for persons or property
guardian.et: From Middle English gardein, garden, (also wardein, > Modern English warden).

s: an angel believed to have special affection for a particular individual
an angel believed to have special affection for a particular individual
The office or position of one acting as a guardian or conservator, especially in a legal capacity.
he is in the care of a bodyguard
m: attention and management implying responsibility for safety
the responsibility of a guardian or keeper
